moqt18.notes: A single draft-18 offer is mandatory. Do not use aiomoqt's multi-draft default in research runs.

moq_lite.notes: Historical/sanity comparison only; it is never a draft-18 result.

relay_candidate.reason: Source audit found cache/fan-out/metrics and opt-in draft-18 code paths, but its own default and documented support remain drafts 14/16. No local draft-18 relay media-path smoke has passed.

raw_quic.notes: Package draft-18 raw-QUIC loopback handshake and object tests passed in an isolated environment.

priority.notes: Initial priority is source/API verified. It is not evidence of a relay scheduling result.

request_update.notes: Serializer/parser exist, but no public, conformant sender on an existing draft-18 request bidi stream was found.

subscriber_priority.notes: Initial SUBSCRIBE priority is exposed; dynamic REQUEST_UPDATE priority is not runnable.

object_delivery_timeout.notes: No public native timeout behavior or expiry/reset observation surface was found.

subgroup_delivery_timeout.notes: Draft-18 property/parameter 0x06 is absent from the audited aiomoqt public source.

forward.notes: Initial Forward state only. Runtime toggling needs unsupported REQUEST_UPDATE.

fetch.notes: Public method and draft-18 serializer/parser exist; no draft-18 relay FETCH smoke is saved.

joining_fetch.notes: Public method and draft-18 serializer/parser exist; no draft-18 relay joining-FETCH smoke is saved.

relay_p1_smoke.notes: Requires a pinned local relay handshake plus 10 deterministic Group pub/sub/payload smoke.

relay_p2_smoke.notes: Blocked by missing conformant aiomoqt REQUEST_UPDATE sender.

relay_p3_smoke.notes: Blocked by missing native timeout API/behavior.

relay_forward.notes: Candidate source has forward code, but no pinned local draft-18 smoke passed.

relay_cache.notes: Candidate source has cache and metrics, but cache reuse is not yet measured under draft-18.

relay_fanout.notes: Candidate source has fan-out code/metrics, but no multi-subscriber draft-18 smoke passed.

relay_p4_smoke.notes: P4 requires a proven relay and dynamic Forward updates; neither prerequisite is complete.

relay_p5_smoke.notes: Requires a pinned local draft-18 relay FETCH/joining-FETCH smoke.
